messages.content: I’ll attach the E2E Long (experimental mode) graphs included in the pull request here for record-keeping.

I’ve meant to ask but what are the axis labels for these charts?

The x-axis represents time, and the y-axis represents accelerator command (desired acceleration).
Positive values indicate acceleration, while negative values indicate deceleration (braking).
Since openpilot runs at 20 Hz, 60 frames correspond to approximately 3 seconds.
